audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gives Gwen Levels 1, 2 and 3 while all three whys say Ornn stat-checks her there and the spike says 'Ornn's lane is strongest here'. First item reads even while its why says your true damage ignores his armour and his tankiness feeds your healing.
audit.why: Gwen wins the lane overall at 52.16%, but only after Hallowed Mist. Before it she is the weaker stat-check, exactly as the early paragraph says.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Ornn / Ornn / Ornn / Skill / Gwen / Gwen / Gwen in both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page treats Searing Charge as a knock-up on demand. It is not — Riot's text: 'If Ornn collides with TERRAIN while charging, the impact creates a shockwave around him which deals damage and knocks up enemies.' No wall, no knock-up. And the page does not connect this to his own Q, which creates a magma pillar — that pillar IS the terrain he charges into.
audit.why: This is the single most actionable thing in the matchup: stand away from walls and away from his fresh Q pillar and Searing Charge is just damage. The page currently tells you to dodge a knock-up that mostly cannot happen in open ground.
audit.corrected: Terrain requirement stated in the whys, the spike and Key Ability Interactions, with the Q-pillar-into-E combo named as the setup.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere, including on the R the late paragraph calls the one thing to fear.
audit.why: Call of the Forge God is 140/120/100s, Volcanic Rupture 9s at rank 1, Bellows Breath 12s and Searing Charge 14s. Fourteen seconds on the charge is the window you step up in.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to the whys, spike and cooldown breakdown.

edits.before: His level 2-3 combo (W Brittle detonated by a Q pillar or E charge) out-damages and knocks you up cleanly before you have Mist to escape.
edits.after: Bellows Breath (W, 12s) makes you Brittle and his Searing Charge only knocks up off TERRAIN — his own Q pillar is that wall, so stay clear of it.

edits.before: You get Q+E to poke and reset, but his base stats and Brittle knock-up still let him stat-check the even trades through levels 4-5.
edits.after: You get Q+E to poke and reset, but his base stats and Brittle still stat-check the even trades — step up while Searing Charge sits its 14s.

edits.before: It's a coin-flip skirmish window: short trades and baiting his Q/E into your Mist drop keep it even while you wait for 6.
edits.after: A coin-flip skirmish window: short trades and baiting his Q pillar into your Mist drop keep it even while you wait for 6.

edits.before: Use Bellows Breath (W) to apply Brittle, then detonate it with a Q pillar or E charge for the knock-up and a real chunk before you hit 6
edits.after: Use Bellows Breath (W, 12s) to apply Brittle, then charge into his own Q pillar so Searing Charge gets the terrain knock-up

edits.before: Drop a Q magma pillar through your lane to wall off your Mist angle and your escape path
edits.after: Drop a Q magma pillar to wall off your Mist angle and give Searing Charge its terrain

edits.before: Ornn's lane is strongest here: his Bellows Breath (W) and Brittle let him stat-check you, and a Q pillar or E charge detonates Brittle for a knock-up before you have Mist to escape.
edits.after: Ornn's lane is strongest here: Bellows Breath (W, 12s) applies Brittle, and Searing Charge (E, 14s) knocks up only when he hits TERRAIN — usually his own Q pillar.

edits.before: Ornn out-stats you levels 1-3, so respect his combo: Bellows Breath (W) applies Brittle, and if he lands a Q magma pillar or E charge to detonate it, that's a knock-up plus a real chunk, not chip you can ignore. Don't walk up to CS through his Q pillar — it blocks your lane and the dash angle you'd want later, and gives him the terrain to set up Brittle. Farm with the tip of Snip Snip! and accept you're the weaker stat-check until your kit comes online; this is the one window he genuinely beats you.
edits.after: Ornn out-stats you levels 1-3, so respect the combo: Bellows Breath (W, 12s) applies Brittle, and Searing Charge (E, 14s) only knocks up if he collides with TERRAIN — which is why he drops a Q magma pillar first. Deny him that geometry: do not CS beside a fresh pillar or a wall, and his charge is just damage. Farm with the tip of Snip Snip! and accept you are the weaker stat-check until your kit is online; this is the one window he genuinely beats you.

edits.before: Track Ornn's Volcanic Rupture: Wall-knockup setup. Don’t get pinned. When it is down — Snip him in your mist.
edits.after: Searing Charge knocks up only on TERRAIN — his Q pillar is the wall. Away from pillars it is damage, nothing more.

edits.before: - Ornn Volcanic Rupture: matchup-defining — Wall-knockup setup. Don’t get pinned. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Volcanic Rupture (Q): 9s — the pillar is terrain for his own E. - Searing Charge (E): 14s, and no knock-up without a wall. - Bellows Breath (W): 12s, applies Brittle. - Call of the Forge God (R): 140/120/100s.

notes: What Brittle actually does is not in the kit file — Riot's Bellows Breath text only says enemies hit by the final gout 'become Brittle'. The page's existing claim that a Q pillar or E charge 'detonates Brittle for a knock-up' therefore could not be verified and I left those words alone where they already stood. The kit file also gives Volcanic Rupture a derived 'grounding' flag that the description does not support; I did not assert it.
